items.title: Clarence Ford Interview, 1975-12-10
items.q: And I played baritone. I was in the band, it's a baritone player.

ctx.x: Did it have some like, like, sling his name on the side? Guitar, Slim and his orchestra. And his orchestra.

Now he traveled in a Cadillac at the time. When y'all would travel in a? In a Ford 55 station wagon. And he had a Cadillac. He had a Cadillac. That would be just like Slim. Well, that's like all those singers at that time. That was the thing. The Cadillac comes in. See, the Cadillac would ride in town facing the band behind. See, that was, make a grand entrance and everybody would come around and they'd see the band and then they'd go to the, we'd always get in town before dark. See the band and they'd come to…
But the band didn't have a baritone. I heard a lot of descriptions about Slim's personality.
